static_traits.name: 陈慧兰
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive circle of friends，但not yet向朋友充分分享自己的not足感
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往心理问题治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，有自我Reflection与配合度；能具体描述trigger情境与自动化思维；存在明显的读心术、预测not yet来、过度概括与个人化等认知偏差

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信潜在伴侣not会对我感兴趣，因为我not认为自己长得足够好看。分手后这种not足感加重，Seeing happy couples时更强烈，影响了自尊、社交，以及睡眠和饮食。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not足感正在影响我的自尊并阻碍我的社交互动。
growth_experiences: 约一年前经历一段关系的结束（分手）。当时压力水平很高，此后自我not足感逐步增强；在Seeing happy couples或与有伴侣的朋友社交时尤为明显。尽管朋友与同事支持，她倾向于将他人的认可解读为礼貌而非真诚，逐渐影响到睡眠与饮食节律，但工作表现基本not yet受影响。

special_situations.event: 与有伴侣的朋友社交或Seeing happy couples
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果I am not good enough看，就have not人会选择我；do not人都成双成对，说明我注定not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing involvement in romance-related topics and situations, avoiding dating opportunities, keeping silent in order to avoid being compared
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会拥有那样的关系；have not人会要我

special_situations.event: 想到再次约会或面对恋爱相关话题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我去尝试约会，就会Being rejected或羞辱；年轻、漂亮的人一出现，我就have not机会
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Withdrawal，找理由not参与约会或结识新人的场合
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Why would anyone choose me? There are so many prettier, younger people out there

special_situations.event: 收到朋友或同事的积极反馈、被关注或称赞
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人对我好，那只是出于礼貌而非真心
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或淡化积极反馈、Displacement话题以避免深入接触
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是客套和礼貌，并not是真的欣赏我

special_situations.event: 回想分手经历、Being alone时反复思考自我价值
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one relationship fails, it proves I will fail in all intimate relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用全或without的标准自我评判，ReinforcementSelf-protection以降低再受伤的可能
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not适合亲密关系，我注定会再次失败

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be genuinely appreciated and chosen, to build a stable and intimate partner relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被羞辱与再次被negate（尤其因外貌）
defense_goal: 通过保持疏离、回避约会来降低Being rejected的风险
将他人的积极反馈解释为礼貌以减少not确定性与脆弱感

object_relations.self_representation: not够吸引人、容易被挑剔与拒绝的“失败者”
object_relations.object_representation: A picky judge / potential partner who only looks at appearance and could reject oneself at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor raises the exploration that 'friends' positive reactions may be genuine' or suggests conducting a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将内心的“not被喜欢/not值得”体验归因于他人的动机，认为对方只是出于礼貌（移情式的对他人动机的负性假定）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气谨慎，反复use“可能、也许、只是礼貌”等词，淡化对方积极性，避免承认被欣赏的可能。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing breakup and self-worth, needs to touch feelings of shame and vulnerability
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 以分析他人动机与Average性规律取代直接体验自身情绪，远离羞耻与Being rejected感
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use客观化、抽象化的语言陈述经历，减少情感词汇与自我感受描述。

manifestations: 分手后在Seeing happy couples或与有伴侣的朋友相处时Reinforcement孤立感
因害怕Being rejected而回避约会和亲密关系尝试
Interprets others' kindness as politeness, thereby weakening the possibility of real connection

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 将朋友的赞赏与笑声解释为“只是礼貌”
预设潜在伴侣会因外貌negate自己，not yet进行现实检验

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁Self-denial：认为“not如更年轻更漂亮的人”
Strongly worries about failure when attempting behavioral experiments, observes cautiously to avoid being hurt

contact_model.definition: The individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向朋友充分表达not足感与真实需求，选择自我消化
减少参与恋爱相关社交，Repression主动接触的冲动

exception_events.target_problem: 在与朋友的社交情境中，来访者通常会认为他人对自己并without真正兴趣，从而减少表达与参与。
exception_events.unique_outcome: Once, at a gathering with friends, she proactively shared a story about a bizarre dream; the friends laughed on the spot and showed interest, and the interaction atmosphere was relaxed and positive.
exception_events.reason: not同做法：主动分享个人经历；not同支持：在支持性的朋友群体中；not同理解：当下更专注于现场反应而非Self-denial。

positive_force: 稳定的职业与not yet受明显影响的工作功能
存在支持性的朋友网络，具备现实支持资源
愿意尝试现实检验与行为实验，具备改变动机
能够通过爱好与自我照护短暂提升自我感受
negative_force: 关于外貌与自我价值的消极核心信念根深蒂固
常见认知歪曲：读心术、预测not yet来、过度概括与negate积极
在亲密关系情境中的回避与Withdrawal维持了Loneliness与自卑
将积极反馈归因于“礼貌”，削弱正性经验的整合

target_behavior.behavior: 在涉及约会/亲密关系的话题或场景中回避与Withdrawal
antecedent: 与有伴侣的朋友社交或Seeing happy couples
想到再次约会或被邀请参与恋爱相关活动
target_behavior.core_reason: 消极核心信念（我not够有吸引力/not值得被选择）与灾难化预测（一定会Being rejected、羞辱）
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的拒绝与羞耻，短期降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 限制社交与亲密机会，ReinforcementLoneliness与自卑，Sleep and eating rhythms disturbed

target_behavior.behavior: negate正性反馈（将他人的欣赏/积极反应解释为“礼貌”）
antecedent: 在社交中获得朋友的笑声、关注或称赞
target_behavior.core_reason: 读心术与对自我价值的负性偏见，避免承认被欣赏所带来的not确定感与脆弱感
